title: Sun Tzu: Stopping War With War
synopsis: Sun Tzu wrote "The Art of War" over 2500 years ago, but it is still read by generals today. Wisely, he realized that the best war is one that does not need to be fought, and tried to reduce casualties through an emphasis on strategy. His wisdom is also applicable to the business world, though he probably never imagined his ideas being used to sell hamburgers!

fullText.simplified:
孙子：以战止战

    武术是中国文化的重要代表，其中的“武”字是其精华。“武”分开就是“止”和“戈”，意思是“停止战争”，象征着武术的真正目的——用智慧终止争斗。这一理念，与孙子及其兵家思想息息相关。
    孙子，名武，字长卿，春秋末年齐国人。他是中国历史上最伟大的军事理论家之一，被后世尊称为“兵圣”。
    春秋末年，战争频繁，各国纷争不断。尽管孙子出身贵族，但仍然无法避免战乱的影响，小时候就跟随家族搬迁到吴国。他从少年时期就开始研读兵书，积累了丰富的军事理念。后来，吴国名臣伍子胥向吴王推荐了孙子。孙子向吴王献上《孙子兵法》，并在吴国担任军事将领。在他的帮助下，吴国一度战胜强敌楚国，成为春秋列国中的霸主。然而，吴王晚年骄傲自满，加上好友伍子胥被害，孙子最终选择退隐，回家修订兵书，直至去世。
    《孙子兵法》共十三篇，涵盖战略、战术、情报等内容，对后世影响深远。其核心思想包括：“知己知彼，百战不殆”和“不战而屈人之兵”。
    孙子强调，在战争中，只有充分了解自己和敌人，才能掌握主动权，确保胜利。他在《孙子兵法》中写道：“知己知彼，百战不殆。”如果只了解自己而不了解对手，就难以制定有效策略；而如果只研究对手而忽略自身优势，也容易陷入被动。这一原则不仅适用于军事，在现代商业竞争中同样重要。例如，面对麦当劳的市场主导地位，汉堡王充分分析自身的优势和市场需求，推出“我选我味”策略，主打个性化定制，让消费者自由选择汉堡配料。这种差异化策略让汉堡王避开了麦当劳的优势领域，在市场上站稳了脚跟。
    第二个核心思想：不战而屈人之兵。孙子认为，战争的最高境界不是战胜敌人，而是让敌人无需交战就主动放弃。他在《孙子兵法》中提出：“上兵伐谋，其次伐交，其次伐兵，其下攻城。”意思是，最好的战略是用谋略取胜（伐谋），其次是通过外交手段削弱敌人（伐交），再其次才是用武力交战（伐兵），最下策则是攻打城池（攻城），因为攻城往往代价最大，损失最重。
    孙子特别强调，真正优秀的将领，应当尽可能通过策略避免战争，而不是轻易使用武力。在战火无可避免的年代，他以“战”止战，尽量减少伤亡，以慎重和理性面对冲突。这种思想不仅影响了古代军事，也对现代社会有所启发。例如，企业在竞争时，可以通过创新技术（伐谋）和供应链整合（伐交）来建立优势，而不必依赖价格战（伐兵）这种消耗性的竞争方式。
    孙子的智慧不仅适用于战争，更成为超越时代的普世智慧。他的《孙子兵法》至今仍被军事家、企业家、政治家研究，展现出超越时空的价值。
fullText.traditional:
孫子：以戰止戰

    武術是中國文化的重要代表，其中的“武”字是其精華。“武”分開就是“止”和“戈”，意思是“停止戰爭”，象徵著武術的真正目的——用智慧終止爭鬥。這一理念，與孫子及其兵家思想息息相關。
    孫子，名武，字長卿，春秋末年齊國人。他是中國歷史上最偉大的軍事理論家之一，被後世尊稱為“兵聖”。
    春秋末年，戰爭頻繁，各國紛爭不斷。儘管孫子出身貴族，但仍然無法避免戰亂的影響，小時候就跟隨家族搬遷到吳國。他從少年時期就開始研讀兵書，積累了豐富的軍事理念。後來，吳國名臣伍子胥向吳王推薦了孫子。孫子向吳王獻上《孫子兵法》，並在吳國擔任軍事將領。在他的幫助下，吳國一度戰勝強敵楚國，成為春秋列國中的霸主。然而，吳王晚年驕傲自滿，加上好友伍子胥被害，孫子最終選擇退隱，回家修訂兵書，直至去世。
    《孫子兵法》共十三篇，涵蓋戰略、戰術、情報等內容，對後世影響深遠。其核心思想包括：“知己知彼，百戰不殆”和“不戰而屈人之兵”。
    孫子強調，在戰爭中，只有充分了解自己和敵人，才能掌握主動權，確保勝利。他在《孫子兵法》中寫道：“知己知彼，百戰不殆。”如果只了解自己而不了解對手，就難以制定有效策略；而如果只研究對手而忽略自身優勢，也容易陷入被動。這一原則不僅適用於軍事，在現代商業競爭中同樣重要。例如，面對麥當勞的市場主導地位，漢堡王充分分析自身的優勢和市場需求，推出“我選我味”策略，主打個性化定製，讓消費者自由選擇漢堡配料。這種差異化策略讓漢堡王避開了麥當勞的優勢領域，在市場上站穩了腳跟。
    第二個核心思想：不戰而屈人之兵。孫子認為，戰爭的最高境界不是戰勝敵人，而是讓敵人無需交戰就主動放棄。他在《孫子兵法》中提出：“上兵伐謀，其次伐交，其次伐兵，其下攻城。”意思是，最好的戰略是用謀略取勝（伐謀），其次是通過外交手段削弱敵人（伐交），再其次才是用武力交戰（伐兵），最下策則是攻打城池（攻城），因為攻城往往代價最大，損失最重。
    孫子特別強調，真正優秀的將領，應當儘可能通過策略避免戰爭，而不是輕易使用武力。在戰火無可避免的年代，他以“戰”止戰，儘量減少傷亡，以慎重和理性面對衝突。這種思想不僅影響了古代軍事，也對現代社會有所啟發。例如，企業在競爭時，可以通過創新技術（伐謀）和供應鏈整合（伐交）來建立優勢，而不必依賴價格戰（伐兵）這種消耗性的競爭方式。
    孫子的智慧不僅適用於戰爭，更成為超越時代的普世智慧。他的《孫子兵法》至今仍被軍事家、企業家、政治家研究，展現出超越時空的價值。

sentences.pinyin: sūn zǐ rèn wéi zhàn zhēng de zuì gāo jìng jiè bú shì zhàn shèng dí rén
sentences.english: The second core idea: subduing the enemy without fighting.

sentences.simplified: 而是让敌人无需交战就主动放弃。
sentences.traditional: 而是讓敵人無需交戰就主動放棄。
sentences.pinyin: ér shì ràng dí rén wú xū jiāo zhàn jiù zhǔ dòng fàng qì
sentences.english: Sun Tzu believed that the highest form of warfare is not to defeat the enemy, ..

sentences.simplified: 他在《孙子兵法》中提出：
sentences.traditional: 他在《孫子兵法》中提出：
sentences.pinyin: tā zài sūn zǐ bīng fǎ zhōng tí chū
sentences.english: .. but to make the enemy willingly give up without the need for fighting.

sentences.simplified: “上兵伐谋，其次伐交，
sentences.traditional: “上兵伐謀，其次伐交，
sentences.pinyin: shàng bīng fá móu qí cì fá jiāo
sentences.english: In “The Art of War,” he proposed:

sentences.simplified: 其次伐兵，其下攻城。”
sentences.traditional: 其次伐兵，其下攻城。”
sentences.pinyin: qí cì fá bīng qí xià gōng chéng
sentences.english: The highest form of warfare is to attack the enemy’s plans; next is to attack their alliances;

sentences.simplified: 意思是，最好的战略是用谋略取胜（伐谋），其次是通过外交手段削弱敌人（伐交），
sentences.traditional: 意思是，最好的戰略是用謀略取勝（伐謀），其次是通過外交手段削弱敵人（伐交），
sentences.pinyin: yì si shì zuì hǎo de zhàn lüè shì yòng móu lüè qǔ shèng fá móu qí cì shì tōng guò wài jiāo shǒu duàn xuē ruò dí rén fá jiāo
sentences.english: then to attack their troops; and the lowest is to attack their cities.

sentences.simplified: 再其次才是用武力交战（伐兵），
sentences.traditional: 再其次才是用武力交戰（伐兵），
sentences.pinyin: zài qí cì cái shì yòng wǔ lì jiāo zhàn fá bīng
sentences.english: This means that the best strategy is to win through cunning (伐谋); the next best is to weaken the enemy through diplomatic means (伐交);

sentences.simplified: 最下策则是攻打城池（攻城），因为攻城往往代价最大，损失最重。
sentences.traditional: 最下策則是攻打城池（攻城），因為攻城往往代價最大，損失最重。
sentences.pinyin: zuì xià cè zé shì gōng dǎ chéng chí gōng chéng yīn wèi gōng chéng wǎng wǎng dài jià zuì dà sǔn shī zuì zhòng
sentences.english: next is engaging in military combat (伐兵);
and the worst strategy is to besiege the enemy’s cities (攻城), as sieges often incur the greatest costs and result in the heaviest losses.

sentences.simplified: 孙子特别强调，真正优秀的将领，应当尽可能通过策略避免战争，
sentences.traditional: 孫子特別強調，真正優秀的將領，應當儘可能通過策略避免戰爭，
sentences.pinyin: sūn zǐ tè bié qiáng diào zhēn zhèng yōu xiù de jiàng lǐng yīng dāng jǐn kě néng tōng guò cè lüè bì miǎn zhàn zhēng

sentences.simplified: 而不是轻易使用武力。
sentences.traditional: 而不是輕易使用武力。
sentences.pinyin: ér bú shì qīng yì shǐ yòng wǔ lì
sentences.english: Sun Tzu particularly emphasized that truly outstanding generals should strive to avoid war through strategy as much as possible, ..

sentences.simplified: 在战火无可避免的年代，他以“战”止战，尽量减少伤亡，
sentences.traditional: 在戰火無可避免的年代，他以“戰”止戰，儘量減少傷亡，
sentences.pinyin: zài zhàn huǒ wú kě bì miǎn de nián dài tā yǐ zhàn zhǐ zhàn jǐn liàng jiǎn shǎo shāng wáng
sentences.english: .. rather than rashly resorting to force.

sentences.simplified: 以慎重和理性面对冲突。
sentences.traditional: 以慎重和理性面對衝突。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ shèn zhòng hé lǐ xìng miàn duì chōng tū
sentences.english: In an era where war was unavoidable, he sought to “end war with war”, minimizing casualties as much as possible ..

sentences.simplified: 这种思想不仅影响了古代军事，也对现代社会有所启发。
sentences.traditional: 這種思想不僅影響了古代軍事，也對現代社會有所啟發。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng sī xiǎng bù jǐn yǐng xiǎng le gǔ dài jūn shì yě duì xiàn dài shè huì yǒu suǒ qǐ fā
sentences.english: .. and approaching conflicts with caution and rationality.

sentences.simplified: 例如，企业在竞争时，可以通过创新技术（伐谋）和供应链整合（伐交）来建立优势，
sentences.traditional: 例如，企業在競爭時，可以通過創新技術（伐謀）和供應鏈整合（伐交）來建立優勢，
sentences.pinyin: lì rú qǐ yè zài jìng zhēng shí kě yǐ tōng guò chuàng xīn jì shù fá móu hé gōng yīng liàn zhěng hé fá jiāo lái jiàn lì yōu shì
sentences.english: This ideology not only influenced ancient military affairs but also provides insights for modern society.

sentences.simplified: 而不必依赖价格战（伐兵）这种消耗性的竞争方式。
sentences.traditional: 而不必依賴價格戰（伐兵）這種消耗性的競爭方式。
sentences.pinyin: ér bú bì yī lài jià gé zhàn fá bīng zhè zhǒng xiāo hào xìng de jìng zhēng fāng shì
sentences.english: For example, when competing, companies can establish an advantage through innovative technology (伐谋) and supply chain integration (伐交).
This means that they do not have to rely on price wars (伐兵), which are a destructive form of competition.

sentences.simplified: 孙子的智慧不仅适用于战争，更成为超越时代的普世智慧。
sentences.traditional: 孫子的智慧不僅適用於戰爭，更成為超越時代的普世智慧。
sentences.pinyin: sūn zǐ de zhì huì bù jǐn shì yòng yú zhàn zhēng gèng chéng wéi chāo yuè shí dài de pǔ shì zhì huì

sentences.simplified: 他的《孙子兵法》至今仍被军事家、企业家、政治家研究，
sentences.traditional: 他的《孫子兵法》至今仍被軍事家、企業家、政治家研究，
sentences.pinyin: tā de sūn zǐ bīng fǎ zhì jīn réng bèi jūn shì jiā qǐ yè jiā zhèng zhì jiā yán jiū
sentences.english: The wisdom of Sun Tzu is not only applicable to warfare but has also become universal wisdom, transcending time.

sentences.simplified: 展现出超越时空的价值。
sentences.traditional: 展現出超越時空的價值。
sentences.pinyin: zhǎn xiàn chū chāo yuè shí kōng de jià zhí
sentences.english: His “The Art of War” is still studied by military strategists, entrepreneurs, and politicians today, ..

sentence_translations: Sun Tzu: Stopping War with War
Martial arts are an important representative part of Chinese culture, with the character “武” as its essence.
The character “武” can be broken down into “止” (stop) and “戈” (dagger-axe).
It means “to stop war”, symbolizing the true purpose of martial arts—using wisdom to end conflict.
This concept is closely related to Sun Tzu and his military philosophy.
Sun Tzu, whose given name was Wu and courtesy name was Changqing, was a native of the State of Qi during the late Spring and Autumn period.
He was one of the greatest military theorists in Chinese history and is revered by later generations as the “Sage of War.”
In the late Spring and Autumn period, there were frequent wars. The various states were constantly in conflict.
Despite Sun Tzu’s noble birth, he was still unable to avoid the impact of war and moved with his family to the State of Wu at a young age.
From his youth, he began studying military texts and accumulated a wealth of military theory.
Later, Wu Zixu, a renowned minister of the state of Wu, recommended Sun Tzu to the King of Wu.
Sun Tzu presented “The Art of War” to the King of Wu and served as a military general in the State of Wu.
With his help, the State of Wu at one point defeated its formidable enemy, the State of Chu.
With this, it became the dominant state during the Spring and Autumn period.
However, in his later years, the King of Wu became arrogant and complacent.
After his close friend Wu Zixu met with misfortune, Sun Tzu ultimately chose to withdraw into seclusion.
He returned home to revise his military treatise until his death.
Sun Tzu’s “The Art of War” consists of thirteen chapters, covering topics such as strategy, tactics, and intelligence.
It has had a profound influence on later generations.
Its core ideas include:
“Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will never be defeated in a hundred battles” and “Subdue the enemy without fighting”.
Sun Tzu emphasized that in war, only by fully understanding both oneself and the enemy can one seize the initiative and ensure victory.
He wrote in “The Art of War”: “Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will never be defeated in a hundred battles”.
If you only understand yourself and not your opponent, it will be difficult to formulate effective strategies.
But if you only study your opponent while ignoring your own strengths, you can easily fall into a passive position.
This principle is not only applicable to military affairs but is equally important in modern business competition.
For example, in response to McDonald’s market dominance, ..
.. Burger King thoroughly analyzed its own advantages and market demand and launched the “Have It Your Way” strategy.
This focuses on personalization, allowing consumers to freely choose burger ingredients.
This differentiation strategy allowed Burger King to avoid McDonald’s areas of strength and establish a foothold in the market.
The second core idea: subduing the enemy without fighting.
Sun Tzu believed that the highest form of warfare is not to defeat the enemy, ..
.. but to make the enemy willingly give up without the need for fighting.
In “The Art of War,” he proposed:
The highest form of warfare is to attack the enemy’s plans; next is to attack their alliances;
then to attack their troops; and the lowest is to attack their cities.
This means that the best strategy is to win through cunning (伐谋); the next best is to weaken the enemy through diplomatic means (伐交);
next is engaging in military combat (伐兵);
and the worst strategy is to besiege the enemy’s cities (攻城), as sieges often incur the greatest costs and result in the heaviest losses.
Sun Tzu particularly emphasized that truly outstanding generals should strive to avoid war through strategy as much as possible, ..
.. rather than rashly resorting to force.
In an era where war was unavoidable, he sought to “end war with war”, minimizing casualties as much as possible ..
.. and approaching conflicts with caution and rationality.
This ideology not only influenced ancient military affairs but also provides insights for modern society.
For example, when competing, companies can establish an advantage through innovative technology (伐谋) and supply chain integration (伐交).
This means that they do not have to rely on price wars (伐兵), which are a destructive form of competition.
The wisdom of Sun Tzu is not only applicable to warfare but has also become universal wisdom, transcending time.
His “The Art of War” is still studied by military strategists, entrepreneurs, and politicians today, ..
.. revealing a value that transcends time and space.
